race.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
race.verdict: GLITTER AND GLORY ran well to finish a close third here last time, and the step up in trip can see her resume winning ways. Love Orchid , African Affair and Chloe's Boy head the dangers in a competitive affair. GLITTER AND GLORY (IRE) LOVE ORCHID (IRE) AFRICAN AFFAIR (IRE)
